|game_text=Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette it is immune to attrition <5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 force to move ship away (for free).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Captain Antilles]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-03-Captain_Antilles-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; pilot icon drawn as on the slip). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-captainantilles-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Captain_Antilles.png]]) show the original text (see [[Captain Antilles]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Antilles]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “[Pilot] 2, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette, it is immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 Force to move starship he pilots away (for free).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The game text above writes the pilot icon “2, 3: any corvette” out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if any corvette)”. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped the comma after “corvette”, printed “<5” and “force”, and changed “move starship he pilots away” to “move ship away”: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette it is immune to attrition <5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 force to move ship away (for free).”<ref name="cl-1273_23-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> (“Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots” is the card list's wording of the pilot icon.)
